name: Yukimura Yoichi
source: Yoichi heeds no authority and likes to bully others, giving him the reputation of a delinquent. No one understands the true reason behind his actions. Surprisingly, he has a soft heart when it comes to animals.
translation: Yoichi heeds no authority and likes to bully others, giving him the reputation of a delinquent. No one understands the true reason behind his actions. Surprisingly, he has a soft heart when it comes to animals.
